name: Coarse-Fine Dynamic Radiance Field
aliases: Compositional Radiance Field with Coarse Voxel and Fine MLP
definition: A dynamic radiance field representation that combines a coarse discrete voxel grid for geometry estimation and a continuous MLP for fine-level radiance, conditioned on global and local animation codes to capture dynamic human head appearance.
summary: Coarse-Fine Dynamic Radiance Field is a novel view synthesis method for dynamic human heads that uses a hybrid coarse voxel grid and fine MLP to avoid cubic memory complexity.
